what: a steel hoe: one flat blade like a garden hoe, about 10 px wide and 4-5 px tall, set at a right angle across the top of the handle and pointing down-left, made of cool blue-grey forged steel, darker and cooler than iron, with a bright white edge highlight, on a long handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold cross-bands and a round gold pommel, a gold collar where head meets handle; never a hammer head nor a thin hook, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, tip at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner
